title: Cubical Stokes: the boundary of an integer polyhedral n-chain is an integer polyhedral (n−1)-chain
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let s be a finite set of index pairs p = (ι, b) with ι : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing, and let β assign an integer to each pair. Let T ∈ 𝒟_n(Euclid P) (domain univ) satisfy T(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} β_p ∫_{(0,1)ⁿ} ω(Φ_p y)(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}) dy for all test n-forms ω, where Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)}. Then there are a finite set s' of index pairs q = (ι', b') with ι' : Fin m → Fin P strictly increasing, and integers β'_q, such that ∂T(γ) = Σ_{q∈s'} β'_q ∫_{(0,1)^m} γ(Φ_q y)(e_{ι'(0)}, …, e_{ι'(m−1)}) dy for every test m-form γ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (β : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → ℤ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.1) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), T ω = ∑ p ∈ s, (β p : ℝ) * ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) → ∃ (s' : Finset ((Fin m → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (β' : (Fin m → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → ℤ), (∀ p ∈ s', StrictMono p.1) ∧ ∀ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, T.boundary γ = ∑ p ∈ s', (β' p : ℝ) * ∫ y in {y : Euclid m | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))
